title: Call and Answer · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Call and Answer · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on a short four-beat call and a different four-beat answer. The lead performs the call and a partner responds with the agreed answer. The partner responds with the correct answer pattern. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Call and Answer, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The partner responds with the correct answer pattern.
recall.why: The partner responds with the correct answer pattern.
